items.title: Smurfit Westrock to buy CMPC’s Chilean packaging assets
items.summary: The acquired assets are positioned near Chile’s main fishing and agricultural areas.

items.title: Is Smurfit Westrock Set to Gain From Its Recent Portfolio Actions?
items.summary: SW's Chile deal and asset rationalization could strengthen its regional footprint, cut costs and support long-term growth.

items.title: What Happens to Your IP Dividend When the Split Closes
items.summary: International Paper is splitting in two, and income investors are about to discover that their dividend does not simply follow them through the separation. What happens to the payout depends on decisions that have not been made public yet.

items.title: Smurfit Westrock, Pratt seek investigation into ‘unfairly traded’ pizza box imports
items.summary: The two companies petitioned the U.S. International Trade Commission and Department of Commerce to investigate and deliver duties for pizza boxes imported from three countries.

items.title: North American containerboard prices rise as capacity cuts tighten supply
items.summary: Mill closures are tightening containerboard supply and driving further price increases despite subdued corrugated box demand.

items.title: Used box businesses eye opportunity amid rising containerboard prices
items.summary: Growth has been a slow burn for two leading used box resellers, but rising corrugated prices could provide a push. Some corrugated experts still question whether this will move the needle.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Smurfit Westrock Stock?
items.summary: Smurfit Westrock has lagged behind the broader market over the past year, yet analysts remain highly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Pricing actions dominate quarterly fiber discussions
items.summary: Executives from Clearwater Paper, Huhtamaki, Mondi and Sylvamo described price increases and other actions to offset challenging market conditions, including a drag from the war with Iran.
